issue.title: bench_tui_jk clan fold-level and link-rail j/k benches record TUI stalls (tui_stalls.jsonl non-empty)
issue.description:
Both nodes fail at the stall-record check
`assert not stall_path.exists() or not stall_path.read_text().strip()`, which means `tui_stalls.jsonl`
beside the perf JSONL is non-empty after the bench. Sites: tests/ace/tui/bench_tui_jk_agents.py:110
(`test_bench_clan_jk_at_each_panel_fold_level`) and tests/ace/tui/bench_tui_jk_link_rail.py:121
(`test_bench_agents_jk_with_and_without_the_link_rail`). Reproduced in two consecutive runs at master
404b0e2ac2 on athena (load average 18.0, then 4.9). In the link-rail bench, the rail p95-delta
assertions just before the stall check passed, so the stall record alone fails it, not the rail
delta. The sase-1eq.5.1.6 (tui-goldens) phase reproduced both ("clan stall", "link-rail") on a clean
base (phase note #2). The benches do not print the stall rows. A worker should first dump
`tui_stalls.jsonl` from the pytest tmp dir to find the blocking handler, then fix the stall or the
fixture that provokes it. Proposed by phase sase-1eq.5.1.6 note #2 and triaged by the sase-1eq.5.1
land agent. The sase-1eq.5.1 epic adds no navigation work.
